description: List expenses (הוצאות) for a building. Optional from and to dates filter the expense date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

from.description: Only entries on or after this date.

to.description: Only entries on or before this date.

name: list_expenses
title: List expenses
